subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` as a new public diagnostics config key, and should it hot-apply through config reload or require restart?
rationale: This issue asks for a new user-facing config surface in a compatibility-sensitive area, and the open PR needs a maintainer-owned decision on the permanent key and reload contract before merge.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, generated config docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queue entries use the refreshed config snapshot.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep the new key but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising config-reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Leave the threshold fixed or solve log noise through a broader diagnostics policy, then close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, generated config docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queue entries use the refreshed config snapshot.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest queue/config feature history and already provided item-specific guidance for this exact decision.
